head.@changeIcon: tooltip on a page's icon above its title: clicking it picks another icon
head.@addIcon: button above a page's title that gives the page an icon (a verb phrase)
head.@addTag: button above a page's title that adds a tag like #exam to the page (a verb phrase)

starters.@region: screen-reader name of the row of ways to start an empty page (Lecture notes, Study guide, Database…)
starters.@startWith: label in front of the buttons that fill an empty page from a starting point (Lecture notes, Study guide, Database…)
starters.@database: button under an empty page that puts a new database (a table, board or tracker) in it; a noun
starters.databaseHint: A table, board or tracker in this page
starters.@databaseHint: tooltip of the Database button under an empty page

menu.@addToFavorites: page menu command; shown when the page isn't a favorite (its opposite is Remove from Favorites)
menu.@removeFromFavorites: page menu command; shown when the page is a favorite (its opposite is Add to Favorites)
menu.@openInNewTab: page menu command that opens the page in a new tab of the window
menu.@modClick: hint beside Open in New Tab: the same happens when the page is clicked with this key held; {mod} is the key's name as keyboards in your language print it (Ctrl, Strg in German, or ⌘ on a Mac)
menu.@altClick: hint beside Open to the Side: the same happens when the page is clicked with the Alt key held; write Alt as keyboards in your language print it, and click as in Open in New Tab's hint
menu.@showInGalaxy: page menu command that opens the Galaxy view (every page drawn as a star) centred on this page's star, with the pages it links to lit up
menu.@duplicateWithRows: hint beside Duplicate in a database's menu: the copy has the database's rows too
menu.@exportCsv: database menu command that saves the database's rows as a CSV file (spreadsheet) in Downloads
menu.@liveSession: page menu command, shown while friends are writing in the page together: opens the panel about that session
menu.@liveSessionHint: hint beside Live Session…: people are editing this page together right now
menu.@inviteFriend: page menu command that asks a friend to write in this page together
menu.@addSubpage: page menu command (in the sidebar) that makes a new page inside this one
menu.@saveAsTemplate: menu command on a database row's page: keeps the row as a template that new rows can be made from
menu.@newRowFromTemplate: menu command on a database template's page: adds a row made from this template
menu.@studyFlashcards: page menu command that starts studying the flashcards written in this page; {count} is how many there are
menu.@fullWidth: page menu option with a check mark: the page uses the window's whole width instead of a narrow column
menu.@copyAsMarkdown: page menu command that copies the whole page as Markdown text
menu.@exportPdf: page menu command that saves the page as a PDF file in Downloads
menu.@exportWord: page menu command that saves the page as a Word document (.docx) in Downloads
menu.@exportMarkdown: page menu command that saves the page as a Markdown file (.md) in Downloads
menu.@databaseInfo: grey line at the foot of a database's menu; {count} is how many rows the database has, {date} the day it was made (already formatted, like 10/27/2026). English keeps "rows" for one as well
menu.@pageInfo: grey line at the foot of a page's menu; {count} is how many words the page has, {date} the day it was made (already formatted, like 10/27/2026). English keeps "words" for one as well

@copiedAsMarkdown: message after Copy as Markdown: the page is on the clipboard as Markdown text
@savedToDownloads: message after a page is exported; {file} is the saved file's name (Biology.pdf). Downloads is the computer's Downloads folder: use the name your language's systems show for it
@showInFolder: command that opens the computer's file manager at a file or folder (in a file's menu, and on the message after exporting all notes)

item.@openNotesPage: menu command on an assignment or event that has a notes page: opens it (its opposite is Create Notes Page)
item.@createNotesPage: menu command on an assignment or event with no notes page yet: makes one and opens it
item.@showInCalendar: menu command on an assignment or event: opens the calendar on its day

assignment.@markDone: assignment menu command; shown when it isn't done yet (its opposite is Mark as Not Done)
assignment.@markNotDone: assignment menu command; shown when it is done, to open it again
assignment.@inProgress: assignment menu option with a check mark: the assignment has been started but isn't done (a status)
assignment.@due: heading in an assignment's menu above the choices of due date (Today, Tomorrow, Next Week, No Due Date)
assignment.@nextWeek: due-date choice in an assignment's menu, under the heading Due: Monday of next week
assignment.@noDueDate: due-date choice in an assignment's menu, under the heading Due: takes the due date away

event.@openNotes: menu command on one class or event: opens the notes already taken for this session (its opposite is Take Notes)
event.@takeNotes: menu command on one class or event: starts a notes page for this session
event.@skipDate: menu command on one date of a repeating event: that date no longer happens, the others stay
event.@deleteSeries: menu command on a repeating event: moves the event with all its dates to the Trash

file.@renameTitle: title of the dialog that changes a file's name
file.@preview: file menu command that shows the file inside the app (a verb); files that can't be shown get Get Info instead
file.@getInfo: file menu command that shows a file's details (name, size, where it's used), for files the app can't show
file.@openInDefaultApp: file menu command that opens the file in the program the computer uses for its type
file.@saveCopy: file menu command that copies the file into the computer's Downloads folder (use the name your language's systems show for that folder)
file.@renameMenu: file menu command that opens a dialog to change the file's name

tag.@renameTitle: title of the dialog that changes a tag's name (tags look like #exam)
tag.@deleteTitle: title of the dialog that asks before deleting a tag

deleteMessage.one: “#{name}” will be removed from {count} item. The items stay.
deleteMessage.other: “#{name}” will be removed from {count} items. The items stay.

tag.@deleteMessage: text of the dialog that asks before deleting a tag; {name} is the tag's name (#{name} reads #exam), {count} how many pages, assignments, events and files carry it. The items themselves are not deleted

export.@progress: message shown while every note is exported as Markdown files into a new folder
export.@progressDatabase: message shown while every note is exported; {name} is the title of the database being read
export.@progressCount: message shown while every note is exported; {done} is how many pages are written so far, {total} how many there are
export.@done: message after every note was exported; {count} counts the pages and databases written, {folder} is the new folder's name in Downloads
export.@folderName: name of the folder an export of all notes makes in Downloads; {date} is the day, written 2026-10-27. Keep Thought Desk (the app's name). Avoid / \ : * ? " < > |
export.@attachmentsFolder: name of the folder in an export of all notes that holds the pictures and files the pages use; lowercase, as note apps like Obsidian name it. Avoid / \ : * ? " < > |
export.@databasesFolder: name of the folder in an export of all notes that holds the databases (as spreadsheets) and their rows' pages. Avoid / \ : * ? " < > |
export.@reservedName: file name in an export for a page whose title Windows keeps for itself (CON, PRN, AUX…); {name} is that title. Avoid / \ : * ? " < > |
export.@missingImage: written in an exported Word document in place of a picture that couldn't be loaded; {alt} is the picture's description

galaxy.@stars: how many pages the Galaxy view shows, under its title; each page is drawn as a star, so they are counted as stars
galaxy.@links: how many links between pages the Galaxy view shows, beside the number of stars (lowercase: it follows that number)
galaxy.@find: placeholder of the search field in the Galaxy view; typing lights up the stars (pages) whose titles match
galaxy.@noMatch: shown under the search field of the Galaxy view when no page title contains what was typed; {query} is what was typed
galaxy.@zoomIn: tooltip of the + button in the Galaxy view
galaxy.@zoomOut: tooltip of the − button in the Galaxy view
galaxy.@fit: tooltip of the button in the Galaxy view that zooms back out to every star
galaxy.@around: label of the chip shown while the Galaxy view is centred on one page's star (after Show in Galaxy); {title} is that page's title
galaxy.@clearFocus: tooltip of the × on the Around “…” chip in the Galaxy view: stops lighting up one page and its links
galaxy.@open: button on the Around “…” chip in the Galaxy view that opens that page (a verb)
galaxy.@starLinks: line in the card shown when the pointer is over a star in the Galaxy view: how many other pages this page links to or is linked from
galaxy.@words: line in the card shown when the pointer is over a star in the Galaxy view: how many words the page holds (a database: its rows together); it comes before how many pages it's linked with, so it's lowercase
galaxy.@starLabel: what a screen reader says for a star in the Galaxy view's list of stars; {title} is the page's title, {count} how many pages it's linked with
galaxy.@list: screen-reader name of the list of stars (pages) in the Galaxy view; each one centres the view on it when focused and opens the page when chosen
galaxy.@emptyTitle: title in the Galaxy view when there are no pages yet
galaxy.emptyText: Every page you write becomes a star here.
galaxy.@emptyText: text under the title in the Galaxy view when there are no pages yet
galaxy.noLinks: Mention a page with @ in another to draw a line between their stars.
galaxy.@noLinks: hint at the bottom of the Galaxy view while no page links to another; @ is the key that starts a mention of a page, keep it as is
galaxy.askTitle: See your notes as a galaxy
galaxy.@askTitle: title of the page the Galaxy view shows until it’s turned on
galaxy.askText: Every page becomes a star and every link a line between them, in a galaxy shaped just for your notes. Short notes shine red, long ones blue.
galaxy.@askText: text under the title of the page the Galaxy view shows until it’s turned on: what the Galaxy is
galaxy.askCost: The Galaxy uses more memory than the rest of Thought Desk while it’s open, up to a few hundred MB with thousands of pages. It’s given back when you leave.
galaxy.@askCost: small print under the buttons of the page the Galaxy view shows until it’s turned on; MB is megabytes, written as your language writes it
galaxy.@turnOn: button that turns the Galaxy view on (a verb phrase); Galaxy is the view’s name
galaxy.@hide: button on the page the Galaxy view shows until it’s turned on: for someone who doesn’t want it, removes Galaxy from the sidebar (it can be shown again in Settings)
galaxy.@gathering: shown briefly while the Galaxy view works out where every page goes, in big workspaces
galaxy.failed: Couldn't read the links between your pages
galaxy.@failed: message when the Galaxy view couldn't load which pages link to which; the stars are still shown, without their lines
